# Test coverage by program

Source: `ctest --show-only=json-v1` of the build; 642 tests, 603 programs. Regenerate with `python3 tests/coverage.py <build-dir> --write docs/reference/test-coverage.md`.

| Programs with… | Count | Of |
|---|---:|---:|
| a `physics` test (answer known independently of DiagHam) | 12 | 603 |
| a `crosscheck` test (agrees with another program or algorithm) | 3 | 603 |
| a `regression` test (reproduces a saved spectrum; change detection only) | 0 | 603 |
| **any of the three** | **15** | 603 |
| only a `smoke` test (`--help`) — physics untested | 584 | 603 |
| no test at all | 4 | 603 |
